subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: Should redirect mode fail closed to the source when the operator session cannot accept the notice, and what operator-visible recovery path must accompany that choice?
rationale: The feature protects source-chat confidentiality but can discard the only operational notice; source inspection cannot choose the intended privacy-versus-observability contract.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Keep the source silent, validate or initialize the redirect target, and surface persistent failures through an operator-visible health or doctor path.

options.title: Fallback to source
options.body: Deliver the notice to the source when redirection fails, preserving observability at the cost of possible runtime-detail leakage.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Remove redirect and once modes and land only owner-approved always and silent behavior.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the source silent, validate or initialize the redirect target, and surface persistent failures through an operator-visible health or doctor path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main history introduced the adjacent global visible-replies policy and spans the affected config and delivery surfaces.
